title: SETTINGS AND KEYS FILL THE SCREEN AS A CARD
why: His Q43 (2026-10-18): windows are a centred card with an X in the corner that takes up nearly the whole screen. Settings and Keys were 720 wide cards; now the card is the screen less 48 px a side, the X stays in its corner, rows keep a 960 column.
now: Settings and Keys now fill nearly the whole screen as one card with the X in the corner.
